label: Compare cognitive-source warrant with physical realization and intrinsic nature
summary: Completed a source-based warrant comparison for #1792, with #1791/#1787/#1731 as the explicit unbuilt source-to-root/intellect continuation. Locke Essay IV.x provides a direct eternal-cogitative-source argument; II.i.9-10 separates finite capacity from continuous exercise, and IV.iii.6 permits endowed thinking matter. Hume Treatise 1.4.5.29-33 directly challenges the mechanical-description-to-causal-impossibility inference. Strawson's Realistic Monism argues against brute experiential emergence but acknowledges the further phenomenal-continuity intuition; Chalmers gives a motivated schematic nonphenomenal/nonstructural alternative, and Broad gives stable irreducible trans-ordinal laws. Physical identity/realization does not by itself establish wholly nonexperiential intrinsic nature. The matched unity test compares Goff's whole-to-aspect subsumption, Chalmers's phenomenal bonding and identity/nonidentity cosmic accounts, and Miller's subject-indexed boundedness repair. Whole-to-aspect dependence has a familiar phenomenal model, a limited positive advantage over bare addition; distinct subjective ownership and its G-ancestry remain unestablished. Nonidentity cosmopsychism explicitly proposes subject-existence grounding; the warrant and selected G translation remain open. Identity cosmopsychism owes restricted access rather than absence of experience. The proposed root endpoint permits n=b, so the distinct-source assessment does not defeat a self-root option. The sources do not yet favor a distinct episode-bearing existential-ground ancestor over the specified alternatives. Capacity, episode, intellectual cognition, historical origin, constitution, existential grounding, eternity and de re necessity are kept separate. No new proof, canonical source attribution, premise closure or root-edge is claimed. Primary locators, positive reasons, scope, rejected shortcuts and revision conditions are preserved in docs/notes/mind-physicalism-fork-419.md#thinking-source-warrant-2026-11-19. The scoped reading succeeded; the mental-source warrant question remains open. Follow-up (2026-11-25): tested same-participant DDC evidence for subject individuation after callosal disconnection against the actual no-fresh premise dc7e315d. In the 2023 control, simultaneous comparison across fields remained at chance with the sequential task's stimuli and positions. The delayed verbal shape report used a different timing and response rule. A cue could reach the side retaining the shape, leaving transfer of shape information and ownership undetermined. Both accounts can identify DDC as the same embodied bearer and share the explanation of task-specific access. The study of reports and task performance supplies no strict G path. Methods, contrary reports, positive replies, warrant and reopening criterion are in docs/notes/mind-physicalism-fork-419.md#does-divided-access-identify-the-source-of-the-experiencer-2026-11-25.

current_assessment.scope: The #1792 thinking-source comparison, including R/T/X and the DDC ownership test, and its application to #1791's mediate no-fresh premise. Other routes to the named targets retain their own assessments.
current_assessment.assessment: Actual cognition supplies a direct starting point for Locke's cogitative-source argument without a prior immaterial-soul proof. Whole-to-aspect explanation has a limited positive advantage over bare aggregation, not an established advantage over developed bonding accounts. The comparison does not currently warrant preferring a distinct episode-bearing existential ancestor to the specified alternatives or establish a necessary rational source. Nonidentity cosmopsychism explicitly proposes subject-existence grounding, with its warrant and precise G translation open. The possible self-root endpoint n=b is separate. Capacity is a candidate support option, not a source-warranted replacement for the occurrence predicate. DDC reported experienced continuity and could verbally report an earlier shape after a cue in the opposite field. A request reaching the side retaining the shape would suffice without transfer of the shape or its ownership. Both accounts can identify the same embodied bearer and share explanatory credit for task-specific access. The question whether organization suffices for that subject's existence without a distinct thinking ground remains open.
current_assessment.next_test: Reopen for a defended criterion distinguishing ownership of a retained item from successful communication, with grounds for tracking that same subject's existence to a distinct actual episode-bearing constitutor by a nonempty path of the selected G. For identity cosmopsychism assess the restricted access and self-root claims separately.
